Maya: Heads-up — BrightCo renewal next month flagged at 35% health. Usage down 48% month-over-month. Need a short save plan.
Omar: On it. What's their committed seats and current spend?
Maya: 120 seats, last invoice $18k/mo. They downgraded to standard tier last quarter; trialed dedicated but rolled back.
Priya: Main issue from onboarding notes: data connectors stuck, some custom mapper failing on CSV edgecases. CS log: https://redwood.atlassian/BRIGHT-432
Jules (Solutions): If connectors are the blocker we can schedule a focused sync with eng-infra. Suggested 2-3 day remediation window.
Maya: Proposed save flow: 1) Rapid data fix (SWE + SE), 2) Targeted enablement session for power users, 3) 30-day usage commitment with credits if we hit X actions.
Omar: Can we offer a temporary downgrade buffer instead of credits? Their procurement prefers predictable billing.
Priya: Idea: downgrade-swap: move them to a "stable" config with lower token caps but guaranteed 99.9% latency SLO for 3 months. Provide migration assistance.
Jules: Engineering impact? @eng-runtime will need to pin a smaller model variant to keep cost down.
CS-bot: @Maya created ticket CS-9832: BrightCo reengage plan assigned to Omar, Priya.
Maya: I'll set up a customer-facing email draft and 1-pager. Need approval for 2 free weeks of dedicated SE time. @Finance can we approve?
Lina (Finance): Quick Q — what's the expected ARR retention vs cost of SE time?
Omar: Retain ~$216k/year vs $12k SE effort. ROI looks positive if we avoid churn.
Lina: Approve provisional SE credit. Need exec sign-off if > $15k.
Priya: I'll arrange enablement webinar Wed 3pm PT. Maya can you share the usage playbook? paste snippet:
``
- Pre-call checklist
- Import sample CSV (shared)
- Validate connector logs
- Post-call success KPIs
```
Maya: Shared deck: https://drive.redwood/brightco-reengage
Jules: After session we should run a 2-week nudging campaign + weekly health dashboard export.
Maya: Customer ok with downgrade buffer if we guarantee migration support. I'll propose that in the email.
Omar: Timeline: fix in 48-72 hours, enablement within 5 days, downgrade buffer applied same day as fix.
Priya: Tagging @renewals: start renewal outreach only after we confirm usage uplift.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update CS-9832 with notes and ping execs if needed.
Jules: :thumbsup:
CS-bot: CS-9832 moved to In Progress by Omar
Maya: Closing loop — will post a short recap once enablement session wraps.
